_meta.note: Two generations added to gpus_act3.json's list for Act V (doc 49). Rents and prices in market_v_chips_v*.csv.
_meta.conventions: nominal USD; kW per rack; grounded flag per value

generations.name: Gen 2037
generations.reasoning: Generic next generation (IV-D28). Perf/W 1.4x the game's 2036 newest class: a 2-year step after 2030 at 1.3-1.5x (measured gains 1.3-1.8x training, ~2x inference per step today [A/B]; Koomey's post-2000 2.6-year doubling [B]). GPUs/MW +10% (the doc 27 rule: GPUs/MW rises modestly); the rest is per-GPU throughput. Revenue/MW 1.25x at launch: part of the gain goes to buyers. Top tier: no denser tier exists after 600 kW racks (mine).

generations.name: Halyard Bowline
generations.available_from: max(the venture's volume quarter + 1, 2036Q1), only if the venture succeeds
generations.reasoning: A specialised accelerator's measured edge over the mainstream GPU of its time is 1.0-1.9x perf/W (TPU v4 vs A100 1.3-1.9x [A]); vendor claims of 10-20x are unmeasured [B]. 1.3x chosen; priced at 1.2x Gen 2037's rent and list price to win buyers (mine). Backers with a reservation pay list × (1 − discount).

gpus_per_mw.reasoning: Designed: +10% on the 2036 newest class (1,050), the +15-20%-per-generation rule tempered by post-2030 slowing

density_rules.retrofit: Same top tier as the 2036 newest class: no retrofit needed to host either

depreciation_and_obsolescence.rule: When Gen 2037 ships (2037Q1), the older classes' renewal_*_gpu_index applies at contract end, as gpus_act3.json
